Path of Vengeance'' |author=[[Cavan Scott]] |cover artist=[[Corey Brickley]]{{Twitter|username=CoreyBrickley|url=status/1578869093720944640|name=[[Corey Brickley]]|quote=Some early sketches for you EARLY SKETCHES nerds (by nerds i mean heroes) that give you a better look at the mysterious creatures surrounding Marda Ro 👀|nolive=1}} |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] |early release=[[April 7]], [[2023]] {{C|[[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]}}{{SW|url=news/star-wars-celebration-europe-2023-exclusives|text=Check Out ''Star Wars'' Celebration Europe 2023 Exclusives from Hasbro, the LEGO Group, and More}} |release date=[[May 2]], 2023{{Disney|url=book/path-of-vengeance|text=Path of Vengeance|subdomain=books}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Hardcover |pages=400 |isbn=9781368082884 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance (audiobook)|Audiobook]] |timeline=[[382 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''The High Republic: Path of Vengeance'' to [[382 BBY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' {{C|Phase II}} |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''The High Republic: Path of Vengeance''''' is a ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' young-adult novel by [[Cavan Scott]]. It was published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]] as part of Phase II of the multimedia project on [[May 2]], [[2023]]. Copies were sold early at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]], on [[April 7]]–[[April 10|10]], 2023. ==Publisher's summary== '''''This enthralling follow up to ''Path of Deceit'' finds cousins Marda and Yana Ro bound by blood but driven apart by faith.''''' ''Marda and Yana belong to the Path of the Open Hand, a group led by a charismatic woman called the Mother, which believes the Force must not be used by anyone. While Marda joins a perilous expedition to Planet X in search of more mysterious creatures to use against the Jedi, Yana finds herself forming an unexpected alliance with the father of her dead lover in attempt to wrest the Path from the Mother's control. These two young women will face a crossroads, forced to choose not only their own fates, but that of the galaxy itself.'' ==Opening crawl== {{OpeningCrawl |name=STAR WARS
THE HIGH REPUBLIC
QUEST OF THE JEDI |text=There is conflict in the galaxy. Chaos on the Pilgrim Moon of Jedha has resulted in a devastating battle. In the aftermath, the Jedi have learned of the involvement of the seemingly benevolent group THE PATH OF THE OPEN HAND in violent interplanetary conspiracies. With communications down, the leader of the Path, THE MOTHER, races back to the planet Dalna to make her ultimate escape. Little do the Jedi know, the Mother is about to unleash mysterious nameless creatures with the power to destroy the Order once and for all….}} ==Plot summary== ===Prologue=== Aboard the ''[[Gaze Electric]]'', the [[Path of the Open Hand]]'s spiritual guide [[Marda Ro]] addresses the religious community about the recent deaths of the [[Jedi]] [[Kevmo Zink]] and [[Zallah Macri]] on [[Dalna]]. Despite her romantic feelings for Zink, she rationalizes that the two Jedi died because they used [[the Force]], which the Path regards as a major violation of their beliefs. Meanwhile, Marda's sister [[Yana Ro]] silently mourns the passing of her girlfriend [[Kor Plouth]]. She had hoped that her cousin's relationship with Zink would have opened her world but laments that she has reinvented herself as a religious fanatic. Blaming the cult's leader Mother [[Elecia Zeveron]] for Plouth's death, Yana reflects on her decision to join Plouth's grieving father, the [[Herald (title)|Herald]] [[Werth Plouth]]'s conspiracy against the Mother. Following the meeting, Yana attempts to speak with her cousin Marda. However, Marda is not in a mood to chat and invites her reluctant cousin to take part in a sparring session inside the gathering hall. Yana, who has more combat experience, wins the round. Yana takes the opportunity to warn Marda that the [[Convocation of the Force]] will not respond well to the Path's message that they have to stop using the Force. Marda believes that the Path should persist with their message. Unable to reason with Marda, Yana agrees to train Marda in an hour in the secondary hold for night-time combat on [[Jedha]]. After Yana leaves, Marda reflects on the Path's teachings about freeing the Force. ===Chaos on Jedha=== With the help of [[Radicaz Dobbs]], the Path manages to acquire an almshouse. The Convocation of the Force agreed to meet the Herald and the Mother played a role in facilitating peace talks between [[Eiram]] and [[E'ronoh]]. However, the meeting between the Herald and the Convocation had descended into acrimony, with the Herald provoking a riot that led to the [[Battle of Jedha]]. Amidst the rioting, peace talks between Eiram and E'ronoh broke down, leading to street fighting, mass disorder and lotting in the streets of [[Jedha City]]. Following the destruction of the Path's almshouse, Marda attempts to contact Yana via [[comlink]] but is unable to reach her. While searching for the Mother, she stumbles upon a gang beating up an [[Ovissian]] man. At the urging of the deceased Zink, Marda confronts the gang with [[Kevmo's lightsaber]]'s lightsaber, killing the [[Kyuzo]] member. Before his associates can gun her down with their [[blaster]]s, a [[Gender|female]] [[Jedi Master]] named [[Silandra Sho]] intervenes and uses her lightsaber to deflect their blaster bolts. She is reunited with the Mother, who was traveling with Sho. The trio attend to the seriously wounded Ovissian, a recent convert to the Path named [[Bokana Koss]]. The Mother convinces Sho to let her lead Marda and Koss back to their ship. Since the Mother has been injured by shrapnel, Koss volunteers to carry her. Elsewhere, Yana leads a team of Path raiders including [[Shea Ganandra]] and [[Barkov]] on a mission to obtain the [[Rod of Daybreak]] from a Jedi vault inside a gigantic statue on the [[Dunes of Contemplation]]. The group unleashed the [[Leveler]] on a [[Selonian]] Jedi guarding the statue. However, they were confronted by a [[Kiffar]] Jedi and a [[Sephi]], who used an ancient gauntlet containing eldritch energies to wound the Leveler. With the Sephi gaining the upper hand over Ganandra, Yana fights the Sephi but is no match for him. Before the Sephi can deal with her and Ganandra, he is attacked by the Leveler. Before the group can retrieve the Rod of Daybreak, Yana receives a distress call from her cousin Marda. Meanwhile, Marda and her group are attacked by a pack of [[reptavian]] [[wargaran]]s, which had been set free by the Little [[youngling]] [[Naddie]], under the misguided assumption that she was liberating the animals. Naddie was mauled by a wargaran but was rescued by Marda before the creatures could inflict more damage. Cornered by the pack predators, Koss joins Marda in fighting off the wargarans. Marda manages to kill one of the creatures with Kevmo's lightsaber. Two wargarans gain the upper hand over Koss. Before the creatures can devour Koss and the Mother, Marda attacks one of the creatures and kills it by biting its neck with her sharp teeth. Shortly, Yana rejoins them and kills the third wargaran with a blaster bolt. They are joined by the Leveler, which proceeds to devour the fallen wargaran. Following a brief reunion, Yana patches up Koss's wound. The Mother orders Yana to obtain the Rod of Daybreak while she takes the Leveler back to Dobbs' starship. Despite Marda's objections, the Mother orders the Path to regroup on [[Dalna]] since its caves will protect the sect from those seeking retribution against them for their role in the Battle of Jedha. The Mother orders Yana to bring the Rod of Daybreak to Dalna once she has accomplished her mission. These new developments cause Yana to question her loyalty to the Path. ===Damage control=== Marda joins the Mother and other Path crew aboard the flight deck of the ''Gaze Electric''. Through the Force, dead Zink counsels Marda to take control but she believes she is not yet ready. Ganandra intercepts a [[Hutt]] transmission that the authorities are investigating the Path for attempting to derail the peace conference. After the Mother learns that the Herald has been arrested by the Jedi authorities for lotting several archives and murder [[Jedi Master]] [[Leebon]], she comes up with a plan to disown the Herald as a breakaway extremist who had acted against the interests of the cult. Meanwhile, at the [[Temple of the Kyber]] in Jedha City, [[Padawan]] [[Matthea Cathley]] delivers rations to several prisoners who had been detained following the [[Battle of Jedha]] including Herald Plouth, who had murdered her Master Leebon. After delivering his rations, an upset Cathley exits the detention block. Cathley is summoned by [[SK-0T]] for a meeting with Master [[Vildar Mac]] for a meeting with the representatives of the other Force religions at the [[Convocation of the Force]]'s hall in Jedha City. At the Convocation hall, the Jedi and the other religious leaders receive a [[hologram]] message from the Mother, who claims that the Herald acted on his own accord when stirring the riots that led to the Battle of Jedha. She says that he was motivated by a lust for power and was grieving the death of his daughter. She apologizes on behalf of the Path of the Open Hand and donates one million [[zukkel]]s in restitution to aid the rebuilding of Jedha City. The Mother also tells Plouth to cooperate with the authorities and make amends for his actions. Suspicious of the Path's true motives ang agenda, Master Mac sends Cathley and the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Oliviah Zeveron]] on a mission to investigate the cult at their base on [[Dalna]]. ===Plans in motion=== While hiding at the [[Enlightenment]] bar, Yana reminisces on her relationship with her late lover Kor Plouth. The bar's owner and information broker [[Kradon Minst]] offers his services, prompting Yana to seek information about the imprisoned Herald. Meanwhile aboard the ''Gaze Electric'', Marda befriends the Ossivian convert Koss. She learns that he was a former [[E'roni]] mercenary who had deserted after refusing to kill civilians and shooting his commander. Due to his combat skills, Marda practises martial arts with Koss. Later, Elder [[Jichora]] summons Marda to attend to the Mother, who appears to be experiencing another seizure. Marda discovers that the Mother is secretly [[Force-sensitive]]. The Mother claims that she receives guidance from [[the Force]]. Back in Jedha City, Yana tracks down the newly-installed [[Chief archivist]] [[Feric Oranalli]] and blackmails him into helping her infiltrate the [[Temple of the Kyber]] in order to obtain the Rod of Daybreak and free the Herald Plouth. The unscrupulous Oranalli had earlier helped Yana and her team raid local temples while searching for the artifact. Meanwhile, Marda returns with the Mother and the rest of the cult to Dalna. After disembarking in [[Ferdan]], they are met by [[Sheriff]] [[Jinx Pickwick]], who denies them permission to send shuttles to their compound rather than via the planet's [[spaceport]]. Pickwick confronts Marda about the events on Jedha but the Mother arrives with the Leveler and intimidates the Sheriff into letting them travel to their compound. From Pickwick, Marda and the Mother learn that a team of investigators have traveled to Ferdan to investigate the cult. Disguised as a Jedi relics expert from Coruscant, Yana accompanies Oranalli to Plouth's cell at the Temple of the Kyber. Yana manages to convince the guards to let her through under the pretext of interrogating Plouth about the Rod of Daybreak. Yana updates Plouth about the Mother's betrayal. When Oranalli reveals he is carrying the Rod of Daybreak, Plouth kills him using the artifact's sickle blade. The two then plot their escape. Meanwhile in Ferdan, Marda meets with the [[Zeltron]] journalist [[Ric Farazi]], who hopes to gain a big scoop by doing a feature story about the Path of the Open Hand. Marda allows Farazi to stay with the cult at their compound. However, the Mother is furious that Marda agreed to facilitate an interview with Farazi, fearing that the journalist is seeking to uncover the cult's secrets. The Mother thinks Marda is too inexperienced for a leadership role and dismisses her. She then meets with Dobbs and two fellow pilots. While watching over the younglings, Yara discovers that several Path members including Koss are preparing to depart aboard three starships (the ''[[Scupper]]'', ''[[Moon of Sarkhai]]'' and the ''[[Bonecrusher]]'') for a mission to an uncharted planet called [[Sophros|Planet X]] to obtain more [[Shrikarai|creatures]] similar to the Leveler supposedly for defense against the Jedi. With the help of Koss, Marda manages to convince Dobbs to let her aboard his ship ''Scupper'' by claiming that the Mother had sent Marda to accompany them to Planet X to ensure the mission's success. Dobbs reluctantly allows her to join the expedition while the [[Reesarian]] [[Ort (Reesarian)|Ort]] lends her a pair of trousers and a jacket. ===Travelers=== On Jedha, the [[Sephi]] thief [[Tey Sirrek]] negotiates passage to Dalna for Padawan Cathley and Jedi Knight Zeveron with the [[Hoopaloo]] Captain [[Strat]]'s starship to Dalna. Before boarding, Cathley confides in Sirrek about her crush for Zeveron. Tey is also acquainted with Cathley's new [[Jedi Master]] [[Vildar Mac]] and comforts Cathley, who is grieving over the death of her previous Master Leebon. Sirrek encourages Cathley to embrace her new adventure before the latter boards the ship. Meanwhile, Yana and Werth escape Jedha by traveling aboard a cargo hauler bound for [[Ord Mantell]] with the help of Kradon. After disembarking at [[Port Mackie]], the duo manage to secure passage to Dalna by volunteering their services as crew aboard the [[Tarsunt]] shipper [[Okut Dand]]'s starship transporting a consignment of [[bergruutfa]] to the [[Marat system]]. As they approach Jedha under the pretext of a fuel stop, Yana tells Werth that her love for his daughter Kor had motivated her to come back for him. Werth tells Yana to return to the Path's compound on Dalna with the Rod of Daybreak. Werth plans to hide on an abandoned farm belonging to the late [[Haq]]. Before separating, Werth tells Yana to check on his wife [[Opari Plouth]] and to spy on the Mother. During the voyage to Planet X, Marda socializes in the passenger hold with Koss, who takes an interest in her relationship with the late Jedi Padawan Zink. Shortly later, Dobbs calls Marda back to the bridge as the convoy approaches [[The Veil (Sophros)|The Veil]], the dangerous atmosphere around Planet X. Dobbs tells the other expedition members that the Mother has sent them to Planet X to retrieve more Nameless eggs. Returning to the Path's compound on Ferdan, Yana seeks out the Mother, who is addressing members of the cult with the Leveler in her presence. During her speech, she experiences a seizure, which an elder explains is a manifestation of the Force speaking through her. After reuniting with Elder [[Jichora]], Yana demands to know what is going on and asks about the whereabouts of her cousin Marda. ===Descent=== Meanwhile in the Veil, the expedition encounters turbulent atmospheric conditions and dangerous flying bolts of viscous liquid. Koss is knocked unconscious by turbulence. Under Dobbs' orders, Captain [[Hal]] of the ''[[Moon of Sarkhai]]'' opens fire on three of the pursuing bolts of viscous liquid. However, this attracts the attention of the other bolts, which collide with the ''Moon of Sarkhai'', destroying the starship with its crew. The ''Scupper'' and ''[[Bonecrusher]]'' proceed with their descent. [[Deezee]] is killed when a bolt strikes the ''Scupper''{{'s}} dome. The [[Force-sensitive]] [[Setaran]] expedition member [[Calar]] experiences a breakdown and [[telepathy|telepathetically]] attempts to convince the others to turn back. When he attempts to force Dobbs to turn out, the hyperspace prospector shoots him dead. After escaping the maelstrom, the ''Scupper'' loses power and descends into Planet X. Elsewhere on Dalna, the Mother invites Yana into her private listening chamber with the Leveler in their presence. Elecia is unaware of Marda's whereabouts and thinks she is hiding. Yana learns that they need to Mother has dispatched several Path members including her honor guard [[Jukkyuk]] on an offworld mission with Sunshine Dobbs. She also learns that [[Qwerb]] perished during the Battle of Jedha. Yana informs the Mother that she has obtained the Rod of Daybreak. The Mother merges the Rod of Daybreak with the Rod of Seasons, allowing her to fully control the Leveler. When Elecia asks about the Herald Plough, Yana lies that he died during an escape attempt. Despite her misgivings, Yaga agrees to train the rest of the Path community to defend the camp from a potential Jedi attack. The ''Scupper'' crashes into Planet X's surface. While the ship is intact, its engines were damaged during the crashlanding, rendering it unusable. Marda is saddened by the death of Calar but decides not to confront Dobbs. Dobbs tasks Shea with restoring the ''[[Silverstreak]]'', a damaged ship that Dobbs had used to travel to Planet X several years earlier, back to flying condition. Meanwhile, the rest of the crew search for Nameless eggs and the ''Bonecrusher''. While traveling through a forest, henexpedition membees otice that the vegetation in the ''Silverstreak''{{'s}} crash site has recovered and deduce that the planet is living and capable of healing. After reuniting with the crew of the ''Bonecrusher'', the expedition sets out to find a canyon where Dobbs had first discovered the Leveler's egg. Meanwhile, Cathley and Zeveron arrive on Dalna, having befriended each other during the voyage. After landing, the two break up a fight between a [[Gormak]] local named [[Athul Taran]] and a [[human]] member of the Path named [[Xander Cran]]. Taran believes the Path are troublemakers and accuses the sect of buying up land and housing on Dalna. The Jedi calm the situation and convince Taran to let Cran transport food to the Path's compound. From Cran, the Jedi learn that Master [[Zallah Macri]] and her [[Kevmo Zink]] did visit the Path's community but purportedly left after allegedly trying to take something from the Mother. Cran is unaware of the missing duo's whereabouts or fate. ===A perilous expedition=== Marda and Dobbs' expedition travel through the lush environment of Planet X. Marda senses that the planet is strong with the Force since she and the others do not physically tire from their travels. During the journey, she discovers that Koss is Force-sensitive and has [[telepathy|telepathic powers]] which enable him to read her thoughts. The expedition reaches the canyon where Dobbs found the Leveler's egg but find nothing. Dobbs suggests that they can find more eggs in a nearby series of caves. Marda encourages the increasingly weary expedition to continue with their mission for the Mother. While traveling through the tunnel to the Nameless creatures' nest, Marda confronts Koss for concealing his [[Force sensitive|Force sensitivity]] from her. She dislikes and fears Force sensitive individuals due to her belief that they misuse the Force. Dobbs' expedition soon finds several Nameless eggs but are attacked by a Force sensitive creature known as the [[Under-Dweller]], which causes Koss to enter a trance and begin chanting. Meanwhile, Yana reunites with [[Opari Plouth]], the ill wife of the disgraced former Herald [[Kor Plouth]], who believes that her husband is dead. She tries to tell her that Kor still lives. The Under-Dweller attacks and devours the [[Barabel]] hunter and captain [[Galamal]]. Marda and the surviving expedition members including Dobbs and Koss manage to flee the cave into a nearby forest. Before the Under-Dweller can catch up with them, the creature is attacked by an unseen force. The expedition flees through the forest but are pursued by the Under-Dweller. Before the Under-Dweller can devour them, the creature is attacked by another creature known as the [[Protector]]. Marda and her companions flee to the ''Silverstreak'', which is being repaired by Shea and her team. Though Shea has not yet conducted tests on the formerly abandoned ship, the Force-sensitive Koss insists that they flee immediately since he can sense the Protector approaching them. While the expedition members including Marda are boarding the ''Silverstreak'', the Protector grabs onto the ramp, preventing the ship from ascending. Koss sacrifices himself by jumping onto the creature and grabbing its head in a chokehold. Marda is devastated by the loss of a romantic interest but the rest of the expedition escape Planet X on the ''Silverstreak''. The other expedition members escape on the ''Bonecrusher''. ===Trouble in Ferdan=== Back on Dalna, Cathley and Zeveron travel to the Path's compound by stowing aboard one of Cran's carts. The two sneak out of the cart once they have arrived inside the compound, which is full of tents and huts. The two Jedi encounter the Zeltron investigative journalist [[Ric Farazi]], who explains she is working on a story about the cult. The two notice that Farazi is sick, with sores inside her mouth. When several Path Littles' including [[Tromak]], [[Naddie]] and [[Boolan]] arrive with soup, her condition takes a turn for the worse and she collapses. The children believe the Jedi are using their Force powers to kill Farazi and alert the rest of the community to their presence. In response to the Littles raising the alarm, a crowd of angry Path members confront the Jedi intruders Cathley and Zeveron. Cathley attempts to convince them that they need to take Farazi to Ferdan for medical treatment. The Jedi suddenly become ill due to the presence of the Leveler, which is under the control of the Mother. The Mother intends to bring the Jedi and Farazi down to the caves under the pretext of "nursing them back to health." Realizing that the Mother intends to kill the trio, Yana convinces her to send the outsiders to Ferdan for medical treatment using the pretext that the trio have an infectious disease. Yana takes the two Jedi and Farazi on a cart drawn by a [[lyuna]] to Ferdan. Away from the malevolent presence of the Leveler the two Force users recover, with Cathley likening her near death experience to the events from the Battle of Jedha. Yana convinces the Jedi that she has no ill intents towards them but that she is taking them to Doc [[Nindle]]'s residence to treat the ill Farazi. While attending to Farazi, Nindle observes that her symptoms are similar to a case of food poisoning that a local child named [[Garda]] experienced after eating a meal at the Path's communal kitchen. While Nindle and Zeveron attempt to resuscitate Farazi with a defibrillator kit, Cathley leaves to find out about the foodstuff that Farazi consumed prior to her illness. She tracks down Yana to a yard behind a nearby warehouse, where she finds the Evereni woman conversing with the fugitive Herald Werth Plouth. Werth wants to expose the truth about the Mother to the rest of the religious community. Their conversation is interrupted by Cathley's [[comlink]] ringing. Following a brief fight, Cathley strikes a mutual alliance with Yana and the Herald in order to investigate and expose the Mother. ===Homeward bound=== During the ''Silverstreak''{{'s}} return journey to Dalna, Marda is confronted by the Force ghost of Kevmo Zink, who warns that stealing the Nameless eggs would bring harm to the Force and the wider galaxy. The crew of the ''Silverstreak'' and the ''Bonecrusher'' find that the Veil around Planet X is trying to prevent them from escaping the planet. Marda helps the Wookiee [[Jukkyuk]] to enter the door to the [[hyperdrive]] using Zink's lightsaber. This allows Shea and the crew to activate the ''Silverstreak''{{'s}} hyperdrive and jump into hyperspace. The ''Bonecrusher'' also makes the jump into hyperspace. The ''Silverstreak'' returns to Dalna with its cargo but the ''Bonecrusher'' is separated and presumed lost in space during the return journey. While Shea weeps for her lost partner [[Geth (Path of the Closed Fist)|Geth]], Marda and the surviving expedition members meet with the Mother and Elders, who take them and their twelve Nameless eggs down into the caverns beneath the Path's compound on Ferdan. While the Mother praises her and her comrades, Marda resolves to exact her revenge on the cult leader for causing the deaths of Zink and Koss, whom she loved. ===Jedi reinforcements=== Back on Ferdan, Farazi dies from poisoning despite Doctor Nindle's best efforts to treat her. Cathley introduces Yana and Werth Plouth to Zeveron, explaining that they have made a deal to stop the Mother, whom Plouth identifies as the true mastermind behind the rioting on Jedha. The Jedi and the disaffected Path members share information about the Mother engineering the theft of artifacts and poisoning Garda and Farazi; the latter of whom has died despite Nindle's attempts to revive her. While discussing how to expose the Mother's deception and crimes, their meeting is interrupted by the arrival of a Jedi starship carrying Jedi reinforcements to confront the Path of the Open Hand. Werth accuses the two Jedi of acting in bad faith while Yana thinks that the Jedi cannot be trusted. After the two Path members flee, Zeveron and Cathley meet with the Jedi reinforcements in the center of Ferdan. The delegation consists of several members of the [[Jedi High Council]] including Masters [[Ela Sutan]], [[Rinn (Duros)|Rinn]], [[Gluth Andoi]], and the Jedi Knight [[Azlin Rell]]. Sheriff Pickwick initially objects to the presence of the Jedi offworlders but relents after learning they are searching for the missing Master [[Zallah Macri]] and her Padawan Kevmo Zink. Sidestepping her more senior colleague Zeveron, Padawan Cathley tells the Jedi High Council members, Pickwick, Nindle, and Rell about what she and Zeveron have learnt about the Path of the Open Hand. Rell tells the other Jedi that he found the remains of Macri and Zink inside a series of caves. He recalls finding that the two slain Jedi had been mysteriously turned into the dust. After the group discusses communication difficulties among the Jedi, Zeveron recalls that Cathley's late Master [[Leebon]], had also been turned to dust during the Battle of Jedha. While Pickwick wants the Jedi to leave her town, Nindle highlights the Path's suspicious activities including their recent property acquisitions and poisoning incidents. Master Sutan decides that the Jedi delegation should meet with the Path leadership in an attempt to resolve the conflict peacefully. ===Mustering for war=== Meanwhile, Yana and Werth reach the assembly cavern, where the Path has gathered. The former Herald confronts the Mother, denouncing her as a false prophet and warning that the Jedi are coming. The Mother instead shifts the blame for the Jedi "invasion" onto Werth. As the enraged crowd attacks Werth and Yana, Marda interrupts the meeting to rally the Path for a showdown against the Jedi. Using her authority as the [[Guide of the Closed Fist]], Marda denounces the Jedi for abusing the Force and renamed the community the "[[Path of the Closed Fist]]." While Werth sides with Marda, Yana voices her dissent and warns her cousin that the Path leadership are exploiting her. Marda rejects her cousin's warning and slices off Yana's right hand, denouncing her as a traitor. After abandoning the wounded Yana, Marda uses the [[Rod of Power]] to awaken the twelve Nameless eggs to use as weapons against the Jedi. As the Jedi and Pickwick's deputies approach the Path's compound, Cathley and Zeveron discuss their differences. When Cathley asks why Zeveron did not introduce her to the other Jedi, the older Jedi Knight confides that she was reluctant to take on Cathley as her new Padawan because she was unsure where the Force was leading her. Zeveron apologizes for being aloof towards Cathley and promises to patch things up with her after [[Battle of Dalna|dealing with the Path]]. During the journey, the Jedi Knight Rell advises Cathley to keep her head down in order to safeguard her Jedi career. ===Ambush on Dalna=== As the Jedi approach the Path's compound, the cultists retreat to the underground network of caves while Shea Gananda monitors their movements through a series of surveillance cameras. The Jedi Master Ela Sutan announces that they are looking for Zallah Macri and her Padawan Kevmo Zink. Under the Mother's orders, the Path's hidden [[enforcer droid]]s open fire on the Jedi and the sheriff's deputies, using the buildings as their hiding places. Cathley realizes that the Path had deployed droids since the Jedi are unable to sense the presence of non-living objects like droids. After the Jedi and the deputies take out the first wave off enforcer droids, Marda uses her position as Guide to summon more Levelers and baby Nameless to attack the intruders. After realizing that the wounded Yana has fled, Marda orders Gananda to search for her cousin, whom she regards as a traitor for not sharing the Path's desire to destroy the Jedi. Meanwhile, the wounded Yana encounters Sunshine Dobbs, who is intended to flee the compound with treasures he believes are owed to him by the Mother. Spurning his offer to run away together, Yana locks him inside the vault. Rell guides the Jedi and deputies into the caves beneath the Path's compound. Cathley catches a Path sniper while Sheriff Pickwick's [[Aqualish]] deputy manages to take out the remaining snipers. Before the Jedi can proceed further, the Force users are attacked by the Nameless, whom neutralize the Jedi's Force abilities, throwing them into terror and panic. One of the Nameless creatures kills Master [[Gluth Andoi]], turning him into the dust. Though several Force-sensitive Path members are killed by the Force-devouring creatures, Marda rationalises their deaths as justified for misusing the Force. Meanwhile, Cathley survives the Nameless creature's attack on Master Andoi and attends to the traumatized Rell. While Sheriff Pickwick and her Aqualish deputy rejoin the rest of the team, Cathley escorts Rell to safety. To calm the traumatized Jedi Knight, they chant a Jedi mantra about being one with the Force. Outside the caves, Yana catches the Path youngling Boolan and learns that the Mother has ordered him and the other Littles to plant explosives throughout the cave system. Shortly later, she is joined by Marda, who initially condemns her cousin as a traitor to the Path. However, Yana convinces Marda to question the Mother's authority after revealing the leader's plot to send younglings to plant bombs throughout the caves. Yana attempts to convince Boolan to tell the other Littles to abort their attack but he remains loyal to the cult leader and flees back into the caves. ===The Battle of Dalna=== As Cathley and Rell venture through the Dalna cave system, they discover the remains of three more Jedi who had disappeared while visiting the planet. Working together, the two Jedi disarm Path members and take out the Enforcers. While approaching a group of Path members led by Herald Werth Plouth who are taking position behind a boulder while exchanging fire with a group of Ferdan locals, they rejoin Zeveron, who is relieved to see the other other Jedi. While Zeveron distracts the Path members by launching a frontal attack, Cathley and Rell use their combined Force powers to dislodge the boulder, catching the cultists by surprise. While the Ferdan locals stun Ploth's [[Dowutin]] and [[Twi'lek]] companions, Zeveron disarms Plouth and apprehends him. A defiant Plouth tells his captors that the other Jedi were punished for using the Force. Seeking revenge against the Herald for his fallen Jedi comrades, Rell uses the Force to forcibly [[Mind probe|probe]] Plouth's mind and learns that the Path's Guide Marda is using a weapon known as the [[Rod of Power]]. Marda and Yana re-enter the caves in order to stop the Littles from carrying out the Mother's plot to collapse the cave system with explosives. They encounter a Path youngling named [[Utalir]], who is being attacked by a newly-hatched Nameless creature, which senses her Force sensitivity. Marda is forced to kill the creature with Zink's lightsaber, damaging it in the process. While Marda is enraged that the Nameless creature has attacked one of their own, Yana points out that the creatures attack all Force-sensitive individuals regardless of their affiliations. Together, Marda and Yara deduce that the Mother is secretly Force-sensitive. While they task Utalir with retrieving the bombs that she and the other Littles have hidden, the two cousins resolve to confront the Mother and put a stop to her machinations. While Ferdan deputies take the captured Dowutin and Twi'lek Path elders into custody, Cathley along with Zeveron and Rell force the captive Plouth to lead them to Marda. While viewing surveillance footage inside Ganandra's watch station, they discover that Marda and Yana are heading to the listening chamber, where the Mother is holed up. Outside the listening chamber, Marda manages to trick the Wookiee sentry Jukkyuk into leaving his post by claiming that the Jedi are approaching. ===Showdown with the Mother=== Inside the listening chamber, Marda finds the Mother searching for the Rod of Power inside the boudoir. Marda tells the Mother that she needs the artifact to reassert control over the Nameless, who are attacking their kind. When Marda addresses her as [[Elecia Zeveron]], the cult leader takes offense, prompting Marda to renounce the Path of the Open Hand. When Marda confronts her about her plot to blow up the cave system, the Mother initially denies it but Marda spots a remote detonator on her belt. The two women fight with Elecia kicking Marda in the chest. Meanwhile the three Jedi are attacked by Jukkyuk, who fires his blaster rifle at them. However, Oliviah uses her Force powers to deflect the blaster bolts back into his chest, incapacitating him. The Jedi and Plouth enter the boudoir just before Elecia can strike Marda with the Rod of Power. Cathley uses the Force to knock the artifact out of Elecia's hand, causing it to land on the floor and break in half. The Mother threatens to detonate the explosives planted throughout the caves, prompting Plouth to turn against her for good. After seeing that one of the Mother's bandaged arms has been turned to stone, Plouth deduces that the cult leader is Force-sensitive and has been secretly using the Force to manipulate the community. Oliviah recognizes Elecia as her lost older sister, whom she was separated from as a child after a [[Jedi Seeker]] discovered her to be Force-sensitive. Elecia recognizes Oliviah as her younger sister and expresses bitterness that the Jedi did not also take her for training despite her Force-sensitivity. When Marda confronts Elecia about her deception, the defiant cult leader tosses the detonator at her. However, Oliviah uses the Force to catch the device. Taking advantage of her enemies' distraction, Elecia reassembles the Rod of Power and summons the Nameless creatures. Their approaching presence incapacitates Oliviah, Cathley and Rell. Since he is unaffected by the Nameless, Plouth lunges at the Mother, causing the cult leader to drop the Rod of Power. Marda snatches the artifact from Elecia, intending to turn the tide of the battle. Cathley is able to fight off the debilitating effects of the Rod of Power and the Nameless by focusing on positive memories from her past, using the opal stones as reference points. Cathley is able to help Oliviah regain control but Rell is overwhelmed by fear and incapacitated. Elecia uses a lightsaber to kill Plouth by stabbing him through his spine. Oliviah engages her older sister in a lightsaber duel. Cathley hands the older Jedi a lightsaber she had recovered from the fallen Master Gluth, allowing Oliviah to gain the upper hand over Elecia. Marda takes advantage of the fighting to flee with the Rod of Power. ===The deluge=== Yana and Marda convince the youngling Utalir to flee the cave before the Nameless arrive. Cathley pursues Marda through the tunnels, placing her faith in the Force. Meanwhile, the Nameless creatures including the Leveler and the new hatchlings converge around Marda, drawn by the Rod of Power. Cathley catches up with the two Evereni cousins but is quickly overwhelmed by the creatures. Marda convinces Yana to evacuate Cathley to safety while she musters the Nameless creatures around her. Marda then activates the detonator, intending to destroy the creatures by collapsing the cave system on top of them. The thermal devices explode, creating large cracks allowing water to flood the underground cave system. Marda and the Nameless creatures are swept away by the flood waters. Yana attempts to rescue her cousin but is separated by loose boulders. Before she can be crushed by a boulder, Cathley uses the Force to hold back the boulder. Yana thanks her before diving back into the water. While unconscious, Marda dreams of encountering her old love interest Kevmo Zink, who thanks her for saving the Jedi and everyone. Later, Marda awakes to find herself lying on a rock. She discovers she has lost the [[Rod of Daybreak]], the first half of the Rod of Power. After securing the Rod of Seasons to her belt, she heads towards the surface. ===Unfinished business=== Cathley escapes the flooded cave system and heads to the makeshift tents that the Jedi and their allies have set up in Ferdan. There, she is reunited with the other Jedi including Masters Ela, [[Vildar Mac]] and her Sephi friend [[Tey Sirrek]]. Cathley also speaks with the traumatized Rell, who gives an ominous warning about the Nameless while chanting the rhyme [[Shrii ka rai ka rai]]. Cathley writes down his ominous message before he is evacuated to [[Coruscant]] for treatment. Cathley decides to return to Jedha but not before paying a visit to her colleague Oliviah. Before Cathley can reach Oliviah's tent, Marda arrives first and finds Oliviah attempting to explain to her estranged older sister Elecia why the Jedi separated them. Marda uses the Rod of Seasons to summon the Leveler, the sole Nameless creature to have survived the deluge. Elecia confides that she is indeed Force-sensitive and offers to share her gifts with Marda. Seeking vengeance against the Mother for her deception and the harm that she has wrought, Marda instead orders the Leveler to devour Elecia. By the time Cathley, Mac and Sirrek arrive, they discover the dusty remains of Elecia and a traumatized Oliviah. Cathley resolves to help her debilitated friend. ===Separate paths=== Later, Yana reunites with Marda, having rescued Plouth's widow Opari, whom she is pushing on a [[hoverchair]]. Marda invites her cousin to join her aboard the ''[[Gaze Electric]]'', where she intends to continue her crusade to free the Force from its imbalances. Yana however refuses to join her cousin's cause, believing that the Leveler needs to be killed. Unable to convince each other, Marda and Yana part company. Yana travels to the ''Silversteak'' and convinces the engineer Shea Ganandra to give her and Opari a ride offworld. Ganandra also reveals that she is pregnant with [[Geth (Path of the Closed Fist)|Geth]]'s [[Shea Ganandra and Geth's daughter|child]]. With the Path of the Open Hand gone, Yana suggests that the three of them could make a living as haulers and visit [[Alderaan]]. Yana also reveals that she has retrieved the Rod of Daybreak, which she found in the caves while searching for Marda. Meanwhile, Marda takes the ''Gaze Electric'' into hyperspace, seeking a random destination to remain low. She has brought the Leveler with her, keeping it in a secure storage unit.
